description:
Dirt Cheap Survival is about the blackout tricks, home-defense habits, and self-reliance skills that Americans used before preparedness became a $12 billion catalog.

WHAT YOU GET HERE
- Blackout and power-outage tricks that run on sunlight, gravity, body heat, and habit
- Home-defense and safe-room methods that cost less than a tank of gas
- Depression-era food, water, heat, and light skills, explained and sourced
- Honest comparisons: what the expensive version actually buys you, and when it doesn't


A NOTE ON SAFETY
Some of these methods involve open flame, heat, and fuel. We flag the specific mistake that makes each one dangerous — read those parts. Nothing here is professional emergency, medical, structural, or legal advice. Check your local codes, and never run an engine or a fuel-burning stove indoors.
